scenarios.name: link_active_gates_axi_admission
scenarios.description: No AR/AW request is admitted before LinkActive acknowledge; admission opens in RUN.
steps: Offer AR and AW before LinkActive acknowledge.
scenarios.expected_result: AR/AW ready stays low before RUN and can handshake only after RUN.
assertion_intent: No core TXREQ/TXDAT producer handshake when link is not RUN.
scenarios.review_note: Include both read and write admission.

scenarios.name: read_fragment_assembly_and_r_stall
scenarios.description: Read narrow/unaligned and cross-line fragments assemble by byte mask and retain R payload during RREADY stall.
steps: Return RXDAT fragments in legal order with DataID values.
Hold RREADY low before final handshake.
scenarios.expected_result: RVALID appears only after required bytes are assembled; RDATA/RID/RRESP/RLAST remain stable while stalled.
scenarios.review_note: Pin-level R-stall assertion passes in the top-level read regression.

scenarios.name: dbid_txdat_comp_and_b_stall
scenarios.description: Write child observes DBID, waits for stored W data, issues all TXDAT segments, then waits for Comp and retains B during BREADY stall.
scenarios.expected_result: TXDAT payload remains stable while stalled; B appears only after completion and stays stable until handshake.
scenarios.review_note: Pin-level B-stall assertion passes in the top-level write regression.

scenarios.name: same_axi_id_retire_order_and_delayed_release
scenarios.description: Multiple parent transactions with the same AXI ID may be outstanding; only FIFO head retires and child resources release after R/B handshake.
preconditions: At least three parent and child entries
steps: Complete CHI children out of order.
scenarios.expected_result: Visible R/B order follows admission order for the ID; child/TxnID storage remains allocated before handshake.
assertion_intent: No child release before matching AXI retire event.
scenarios.review_note: Read and write paths both require coverage.

scenarios.name: axi_and_chi_error_mapping
scenarios.description: Unsupported WRAP, invalid WLAST/WSTRB, RXDAT/RXRSP errors and early CompDBIDResp follow specified DECERR/SLVERR behavior without receive FIFO deadlock.
steps: Drive one error source per transaction.
scenarios.expected_result: WRAP returns DECERR at admission; runtime/protocol/CHI errors return SLVERR; unknown flits are consumed without context mutation.
assertion_intent: Unknown RX flit does not update a valid child.
scenarios.review_note: Need a matrix proving every specified error source.

scenarios.name: supported_width_profiles
scenarios.description: Elaboration accepts only supported AXI/CHI/cache-line geometry and preserves byte ownership for each supported relation.
steps: Run narrow and cross-line byte-map tests.
scenarios.expected_result: Supported profiles compile and data maps correctly; invalid geometry is rejected at elaboration.
assertion_intent: Parameter elaboration checks fire for invalid geometry.
scenarios.review_note: Run all declared profiles, not only default.

scenarios.name: normal_link_power_down
scenarios.description: Stop AXI admission, drain contexts and TX/RX queues, then remove LinkActive.
steps: Request normal drain with traffic in flight.
Observe admission, queue drain and LinkActive removal.
scenarios.expected_result: Behavior cannot be verified until the control signal and AXI semantics are specified.
assertion_intent: No new admission after drain request; LinkActive removed only when all queues/context are empty.
